fluff.overview: Com Guard conventional infantry benefit from ComStar's access to preserved Star League technology, fielding weapons and equipment that match or exceed the standard issue of any Inner Sphere military, backed by the institutional discipline of the secular Order's professional military culture. Mechanized wheeled Level I formations use wheeled APCs that provide a balance of road speed, infantry protection, and maintenance economy. The Com Guards deploy wheeled mechanized infantry extensively for garrison and patrol duties on worlds with developed transportation networks. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
